name: Kubo 2022
paper_title: Herd guidance by multiple sheepdog agents with repulsive force
authors: M. Kubo, M. Tashiro, H. Sato, et al.
mechanism: Multiple sheepdogs apply repulsive social forces. Dog-dog repulsion (K_f4) encourages a semi-circular formation behind the flock while dogs target the sheep farthest from the goal.
